sar.reason: Policy R6 and R9: coordinated fraud syndicate operating through shared device profile infrastructure across multiple customer accounts
sar.narrative: On 2016-11-22, an organized fraud scheme was identified targeting payment card C13487-K1 belonging to customer C13487 via transaction 3478561 ($74.96 USD). Graph analysis utilizing TigerGraph multi-hop neighbor traversal identified that the originating device profile (SM-G935F Build/NRD90M | Android 7.0 | chrome 62.0 for android | 1920x1080) was utilized concurrently across multiple unrelated card accounts. The device configuration utilizes anonymous proxy routing (IP_PROXY:ANONYMOUS) to conceal perpetrator geographical origin while executing automated card charges. Senior fraud analysts cross-referenced the device signature and verified linked suspicious activity across three distinct card portfolios. The methodology reflects an undocumented automated device farm attack designed to bypass velocity rules by distributing small transactions across independent identities. Pursuant to bank policy rules R6 and R9, an external suspicious activity report is filed to alert FinCEN regarding this coordinated credential syndicate. Affected payment card C13487-K1 and all connected cardholder instruments sharing this device profile have been placed under elevated monitoring. This narrative details the systemic hardware footprint to facilitate inter-institution ring identification and prosecution.
